correlates.name: Maxillary Sinusitis
correlates.presentation: Most common site of sinusitis of all the paranasal sinuses.
correlates.pathophysiology: The maxillary sinus ostium sits high on the medial sidewall of the sinus, so drainage is inherently poor; the sinus depends on a mechanical "pump" generated by motion between the maxilla and the zygoma.
correlates.treatment: Zygomatic (maxillary) lift to restore zygoma-maxilla motion and the sinus pump; the frontal lift and nasion spread address frontal/ethmoid sinus drainage.

correlates.name: Tension Headache
correlates.presentation: Bilateral, sharp headaches at the temples, feeling "around the head" (band-like), lasting 1-2 hours, severity 3-8/10, associated with work stress.
correlates.pathophysiology: Stress-associated headache with prominent musculoskeletal contributors — in this patient: forward head carriage, protracted shoulders, paravertebral and trapezius muscle spasm, and cervical/OA somatic dysfunction.
correlates.treatment: OMT plus lifestyle — walking 30 min/day, meditation/prayer for stress, cervical and pectoral stretching, rhomboid strengthening. Antidepressants and biofeedback/CBT are options she declined or cannot access.
